thread:
sam: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands 1: we promised clearer guidance on strategy and team priorities. Dropping an open Q&A thread for anything we missed. I'll kick off with a question for product/infra leads: given customer asks, where should we bias engineering effort in H2?

maria: Short answer: stabilize the core runtime and expand operational features. More context: focus on reliability/SLAs, routing fallbacks, and observability. New UX and catalog polish after those foundations.

jin: Can you be concrete on 'stabilize'? Are we targeting latency p99 improvements, throughput scaling, or failure modes first?

maria: All three but ordered: (1) failure-mode resilience + graceful degradation, (2) p99 latency improvements on common seq lengths, (3) horizontal scaling for peak throughput. We'll provide measurable targets next week.

drew: From GTM: customers repeatedly ask for easier Dedicated onboarding and clearer ROI. Is that a priority for product?

sam: Yes. Make Dedicated onboarding lower friction is high priority 1: simplify contracts, provide migration playbooks, and automate infra checks.

zoe: On messaging: do we tweak the external mission? Some prospects asked if "developer-first" implies less enterprise focus.

sam: Mission stays developer-first but we'll add a production-centric tagline for go-to-market. Example: "Production economics for LLM inference" 1: signals cost, latency, and operational control.

lisa: Competitor question: how should teams react when a vendor competes on price aggressively?

sam: We don't try to be the absolute lowest price. Instead: sharpen our cost tooling (Optimize) and show the total cost of ownership and operational benefits (observability, fallbacks, predictable SLOs).

jin: Roadmap ask: should infra prioritize smarter auto-routing/fallbacks or richer model catalog metadata? We need to sequence work.

maria: Prioritize auto-routing/fallbacks. That directly reduces customer incidents. Catalog metadata improvements in the next cycle.

ops-bot: Reminder: Strategy sync Thu 11:00 1 UTC 1 Add agenda items here: https://redwood.internal/strategy (automated message)

drew: Will CS get an early-warning flag when a workspace is nearing Dedicated eligibility so we can proactively contact them?

maria: Yes 1 implementing a dashboard flag combining spend velocity, request patterns, and SLO needs. Pilot for a few accounts next month.

zoe: One-sentence external positioning for marketing? Need something concise for decks.

sam: Draft: "Redwood Inference delivers predictable, observable, and cost-aware LLM inference across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments so teams ship reliable AI features without owning the stack."

lisa: Love it. Suggest swapping 'cost-aware' for 'cost-effective' to emphasize unit economics.

sam: Sounds good. I'll finalize and post it in #marketing. Thanks all 1 keep flagging anything else here and we'll incorporate into the playbook update.
